text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Turn here,
and... that building over there.
—...Oh? ...Trainer!
choice_data_list: Pisa! What a coincidence. Are you ...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, to the museum.
Hehe...
They're holding a special gem exhibition
right now.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I heard they even have various kinds of
turquoise from all over the world on
display...
I've been looking forward to this for so
long! ♪

Out of all gemstones,
turquoise was her favorite.
Listening to her speak so happily piqued my
curiosity as well.
choice_data_list: Would it be okay... if I came alon...
Do you mind... if I come along too?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... please do! Hehe... I'm so glad
you've taken an interest in gemstones too,
Trainer! ♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(You're always so willing to share in what
I love.
In that case...
I have to make today a wonderful day.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let's go find a brilliance...
that will stay in your heart forever! ♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my...! Look at this, Trainer!
The cut on this diamond is magnificent...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, truly gorgeous...
And this little one...
It looks like it was deeply cherished by
its owner for a very long time.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I watched my parents work with them up close
all my life...
Hehe...
Gemstones are surprisingly talkative little
things, you know.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
This place is simply overflowing with memories
and feelings.
I love chatting with them so much...
I can't help getting excited! ♪

And so,
alongside a light-footed Victoire Pisa,
I enjoyed browsing through the gemstone
exhibits, but—

In front of one particular display case,
her expression clouded over.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—...This gemstone...
...has such a sorrowful color...

Displayed where her gaze fell was a turquoise
earring.
However—
choice_data_list: It's an earring, but there's only ...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...According to the placard,
the other one...
'was scattered during inheritance,
its whereabouts unknown'...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Only the right earring...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The space beside it... has been left open.
Almost as if it's waiting for its missing
half...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps the owner left it that way with a
wish...
'that they might meet again'...

Just then,
I notice an elderly woman standing beside
Victoire Pisa.
She, too, was gazing intently at the earring,
lost in time.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —...Could it be...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Um... excuse me.
Does this earring happen to look...
familiar to you?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text: Eh...? Whatever do you mean...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for asking out of the blue.
It's just that from your gaze,
I felt a deep affection...
and a faint flicker of hope.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
My word... Well,
yes... I felt as though I'd seen something
very similar to this jewelry back when I
was a child...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Though... it must be my imagination.
Forgive me for rambling on like that...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, it's very intriguing.
If you wouldn't mind...
could you tell us just a little more?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Even the smallest detail...
could become an invaluable clue
in reuniting these earrings.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
Why... why are you going so far for this,
my dear?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Because from this gemstone—...
I can feel such a profound loneliness.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Or perhaps...
the sorrow and heartfelt wish of those
yearning for a reunion.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
If there is any way to connect them...
I want to bring them together once more.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Connecting a pair of earrings meant to be
as one, connecting happiness—...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Please... would you lend us your help?
choice_data_list: She's the daughter of a jeweler.

text_block_list.text:
She understands and treasures the bonds and
encounters between people, gems,
and all things...
And she genuinely wishes to save anything
suffering from loneliness.

She is prepared to give her all to connect
irreplaceable bonds.
—I poured my heart into conveying why she
should place her trust in Pisa.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
...What a curious pair you are.
To tell the truth... long ago,
I seem to recall my mother talking about
inheriting some jewelry.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
—...If it's anywhere,
it would be at my family home.
I'll arrange things with them, so please,
do come by and search.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't seem to be in any of the jewelry
boxes you gathered...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
I suppose not.
It was never going to be simple.
Still,
where else could we possibly look...?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
—... For example... what about somewhere
connected to your mother?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Even if it was just one half...
if it was precious to her...
perhaps it was tucked away...
carefully kept safe.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
An old chest of drawers...
In the room my mother used
to use as her own,
there is a large antique chest.
I shall lead you there.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
What a magnificent chest...
Perhaps inside...
—......... Ah...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
This jewelry box...
It must have held deep sentimental value.
It's very old,
but there are traces of it being repaired
again and again...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text: Could it be... inside here...?
The woman gently opens the lid. And then—

text_block_list.name: Elderly Woman
text_block_list.text:
This is it...!
To think we would actually find it...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... thank goodness. With this,
they can be reunited once more.

To confirm, we returned to the jewelry
exhibition along with the earring we
found.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Yes,
they truly are a pair.
While it can't be displayed
alongside the other right away...
I'm sure that someday, surely—

Victoire Pisa breaks into an affectionate,
tender smile.
It was an angelic smile,
joyfully celebrating their reunion.
choice_data_list: I'm so glad... It's all thanks to you.
I'm so glad... It's all thanks to you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... Your smile...
is so... so very radiant...
choice_data_list: Well, I'm just so happy they're fi...
Well, I'm just so happy they're fi...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(You care as if it happened to you...
You're sharing your heart... with mine.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(...—It's filling me up.
It reaches me so deeply,
overflowing with warmth...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I can truly feel it.
Your joy... your happiness.
